message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942–1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army, commanded by General Fyodor Kharitonov (later General Georgy Zhukov).
• **Nazi Germany** – Wehrmacht’s 6th Army, led by General Friedrich Löhmann (later General Fedor von Bock).
• **Axis Allies** – Italian, Romanian, Hungarian, and German auxiliary units supported the German effort. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now Volgograd) in southwestern Russia, on the western bank of the Volga River. The battle encompassed the entire city and its surrounding industrial and residential districts. | The confrontation became one of the deadliest and most pivotal battles of World War II, ultimately turning the tide in favor of the Allies on the Eastern Front.
